item.title: New Zealand–Australia: Empowering Clean Energy and Digital Innovation
item.description: Australia and New Zealand are deepening collaboration on clean energy and sustainable finance to accelerate the net-zero transition, strengthen resilience and create long-term economic opportunities.

item.title: Hong Kong: Civic Engagement to Strengthen Innovation
item.description: Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation is linking civic participation with community initiatives to reinforce a stable policy environment that supports long-term innovation and technological growth.

item.title: Indonesia: QRIS Boosts SME Growth and Financial Inclusion
item.description: Indonesia’s widespread adoption of QRIS is significantly boosting SME investment efficiency, promoting financial inclusion and supporting sustainable economic growth both domestically and internationally.

item.title: Singapore: ASEAN Universities Adapt to the AI-Driven Era
item.description: ASEAN university leaders are advancing coordinated strategies to integrate AI into teaching, research and campus governance while preserving trust, ethics and the human connections essential to education.

item.title: Malaysia: Selangor Automated Distribution for Smarter Supply Chains
item.description: Selangor is developing a large-scale automated distribution hub to enhance logistics efficiency, strengthen supply chain resilience and support Malaysia’s shift toward advanced, data-driven operations.

item.title: Australia: Victoria Promotes Digital Inclusion and Service Efficiency
item.description: The Victorian Government is funding CISVic with over AU$242,000 to improve digital access and provide tailored support for all residents confidently navigating essential online consumer and rental services.

item.title: India: Focus on Blue Economy and AI for Sustainable Growth
item.description: India is advancing sustainable growth through a dual focus on developing its blue economy and leveraging artificial intelligence to drive innovation, employment, economic opportunities and global competitiveness.

item.title: Hong Kong PolyU’s Hefei Hub for Cross-Regional Innovation
item.description: Hong Kong Polytechnic University has launched its Hefei Institute of Technology and Innovation to strengthen cross-regional collaboration in aerospace, biomedical research and technology commercialisation.

item.title: Vietnam-Canada AI-Driven Precision Medicine Collaboration
item.description: Vietnam is exploring collaboration with Canada to leverage AI and genomic data for precision medicine, strengthening healthcare and national innovation, enhancing treatment of rare diseases and advancing digital healthcare.

item.title: Singapore: Advancing AI Fluency with New Centre of Excellence
item.description: Singapore has launched a new AI Centre of Excellence to advance workforce readiness, skills development and significantly strengthen responsible, trusted and ethical AI innovation across the financial sector.
